text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2% over the last day, suggesting a mild pullback rather than panic selling. Fear & Greed remains in greed territory at 67, though it has weakened by 7 points over the week, indicating sentiment is cooling from earlier peaks. Bitcoin dominance at 59.2% and $92B in daily volume show the market is still fairly engaged, with no sharp flight to safety or liquidity collapse.
